raw_segments.text: Macduff, boundless intemperance in nature is a tyranny.
It hath been th, untimely emptying of the happy throne and fall of many kings.
But fear not yet to take upon you what is yours.
You may convey your pleasures in a spacious plenty, and yet seem cold, the time you may
We have willing dames enough, there cannot be that vulture in you, to devour so many
as will to greatness dedicate themselves, finding it so inclined.
